purpose: Test construction-axis chirality reflection with identical optimizer-representable tokens, score configuration, and magnetic-axis branch between screening and Adam step 0.

generator.only_explicit_physical_input_change: multiply every construction reference-axis vertical Fourier coefficient by -1
generator.construction_axis_transform: Z(phi) is reflected for the same seed while radial coefficients and all sampled scalar parameters are unchanged

start_representation.order: generate float64 analytic tokens, map to exact-unclipped float32 standardized data coordinates, reconstruct physical tokens, then screen and optimize those same reconstructed tokens
start_representation.source_quantization_diagnostics: record source-to-start geometry and current relative RMS separately from the float32 self-roundtrip

score_configuration.optimizer_step0_axis_policy: strict mixed-precision continuation from screened axis_R/axis_Z

screening.adam200_gate: native status == ok, finite screened axis_R/axis_Z, and strict-hint optimizer step-0 score within 0.1 of screening
screening.sampling: independent deterministic streams, one per GPU; no fixed population size

optimizer.direction_policy: fresh random orthogonal directions per update

resources.soft_deadline_behavior: finish the active Adam200 trajectory, then exit without sampling another candidate

smoke.reason: This case differed by about 1.85 under v2 and v3 and therefore exercises axis, representation, and score-configuration consistency.

monitoring.per_worker: screening status, strict-hint step-0 consistency, valid abundance, initial and best iota signs, active trajectory, maximum best score, and count at score>=70
monitoring.final: aggregate screening abundance, Adam200 outcomes, handedness, thresholds, runtime, and valid-case accounting

default_impact: none; qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remains the current default
